semanticPurpose: D1 네기마 조립의 생 닭다리살 한 조각이다. 런타임은 MDL-SKEWER-BASE의 slot anchor에 skewerSocket을 결합해 닭→파→닭→파→닭 순서를 구성한다.

sourceReferences.role: user-approved D1 assembly full-screen source; direct visual reference for raw chicken form, palette, dark pixel contour, and material density

contractReferences.role: MDL-INGREDIENT-CHICKEN model contract: skewerSocket, cut-face UV, and 800-triangle limit

generation.tool: deterministic Three.js GLTFExporter with built-in imagegen texture source
generation.textureMode: single raw chicken-thigh pixel-art material derived from the user-approved D1 source
generation.promptSummary: exactly one coherent bite-sized raw chicken-thigh piece; retain source palette, marbling, cream-fat highlights, and dark pixel contour; no skewers, other food, UI, scene, or shadow; uniform #00ff00 chroma-key background
postProcess: remove_chroma_key.py with border auto-key, soft matte, threshold 12/220, and despill
nearest-neighbor normalization to 192×192 RGBA pixel albedo
GLB front material plane bound to the albedo while a low-poly body supplies depth
actual GLB plus albedo rendered alone on a neutral checkerboard

validation.glbParse: root origin [0,0,0]; skewerSocket and pixel-material-plane present

contains: one MDL-INGREDIENT-CHICKEN GLB with its pixel albedo

excludes: green onion, bamboo skewer, cooked chicken, a pile of separate ingredients, jig, transfer tray, ingredient bin, background scene, character, UI, text, quantity, checkmark, shadow, or VFX
state-specific raster frames or a baked completed skewer
approvalQuestion: 생 닭다리살 모델 bundle 한 개만 검토한다. 승인 D1 원본의 생 닭 질감·픽셀 윤곽·색 밀도와 어울리는지, 한 조각으로 명확히 읽히는지, 투명 경계가 깨끗한지 확인한다. 꼬치·대파·완성 꼬치는 이 후보에 포함하지 않는다.
nextGate: MDL-INGREDIENT-NEGI 한 모델을 같은 방식으로 별도 격리 검수한다.
